fact: Madagascar-Tribune, a Madagascar news site, published a piece questioning the government's cybercrime bill n°042/2026, saying the permanent access powers of its new digital police (article 75) raise issues of public freedoms and of balance with freedom of expression, and contrasting it with the stalled access-to-information bill; the document is dated 2026-09-03 and gives no earlier date.
